bio.zh: 美國佛羅里達大學結構工程博士。曾任國防大學理工學院教授兼軍事工程組組長、美國佛羅里達大學訪問學者，現任陽明交大土木系副教授暨土木結構大樓中心主任。
bio.en: Ph.D. in Structural Engineering, University of Florida. Formerly Professor and Head of the Military Engineering Division at the Chung Cheng Institute of Technology, National Defense University, and Visiting Scholar at the University of Florida. Now Associate Professor of Civil Engineering at NYCU.
